---
name: Security Advisory
about: Report a security vulnerability in Echo Nightly
description: Private vulnerability reporting
labels: security, confidential
assignees: ''
---

**IMPORTANT:** Please do NOT open a public issue for security problems.

Describe the vulnerability:
- Affected version / build
- Steps to reproduce (minimal and complete)
- Impact assessment
- Suggested fix (if available)
- Whether it is already publicly disclosed

We will acknowledge within 5 business days and aim to fix within 30 days.
